name: inheritance2.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (dobj Ref)(RESULT_8 Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (a Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (a Int)(b Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (a Int)(c Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D (mk-D (a Int)(c Int)(d Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  (lift-D (sel-D D))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D ((this Ref)) D
  (sel-D (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-D this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.dobj: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!dobj ((this Ref)) Ref
  (dobj (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.RESULT_8: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!RESULT_8 ((this Ref)) Int
  (RESULT_8 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.a: ---

(define-fun A!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.a: ---

(define-fun B!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.b: ---

(define-fun B!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-B this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class C:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for C.a: ---

(define-fun C!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.c: ---

(define-fun C!c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-C this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class D:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for D.a: ---

(define-fun D.a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-D this))
)

(define-fun D!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-D this))
)

; --- getters for D.c: ---

(define-fun D.c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-D this))
)

(define-fun D!c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-D this))
)

; --- getters for D.d: ---

(define-fun D.d ((this Ref)) Int
  (d (deref-D this))
)

(define-fun D!d ((this Ref)) Int
  (d (deref-D this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!RESULT_8 this) (+ (+ (D.a (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this)) (D.c (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this))) (D.d (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this))))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-D (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert2))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 2) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!b this) 2)
)

(assert (! (B.inv2 2) :named _xkassert4))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-C C)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun C.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (C.inv1 3) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun C.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!c this) 3)
)

(assert (! (C.inv2 3) :named _xkassert6))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class D:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-D D)
(declare-const const-5-D D)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun D.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (D.inv1 4) :named _xkassert7))
(assert (! (D.inv1 5) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun D.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!c this) 3)
)

(assert (! (D.inv2 4) :named _xkassert9))
(assert (! (D.inv2 5) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun D.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!d this) 4)
)

(assert (! (D.inv3 4) :named _xkassert11))
(assert (! (D.inv3 5) :named _xkassert12))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-B const-2-B))
        3 (lift-C const-3-C))
        4 (lift-D const-4-D))
        5 (lift-D const-5-D))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-D (select heap 4))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (= (d (sel-D (select heap 5))) 4))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-A (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-B (select heap 2))) 1))
(define-fun const-5-D () D
  (mk-D 1 3 4))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-C (select heap 3))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (= (c (sel-D (select heap 4))) 3))
(define-fun const-2-B () B
  (mk-B 1 2))
(define-fun const-3-C () C
  (mk-C 1 3))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (= (d (sel-D (select heap 4))) 4))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (dobj (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (RESULT_8 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
     (+ (a (sel-D a!1)) (c (sel-D a!1)) (d (sel-D a!1))))))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (c (sel-C (select heap 3))) 3))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 5 8))
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 1))
(define-fun const-4-D () D
  (mk-D 1 3 4))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-D (select heap 5))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (= (c (sel-D (select heap 5))) 3))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (dobj (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-D a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (b (sel-B (select heap 2))) 2))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 5 8)))
                  1
                  (lift-A (mk-A 1)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 2 (lift-B (mk-B 1 2))) 3 (lift-C (mk-C 1 3)))))
  (store (store a!2 4 (lift-D (mk-D 1 3 4))) 5 (lift-D (mk-D 1 3 4))))))
